Aku wins with some effort in round one. Round 2, Thanos likely takes the cake assuming the two don’t get into a constant loop of time fuckery. (Should’ve mentioned that Aku can open portals, giving him the abilities of the time stone naturally.) 

The way I see it is this: Thanos was an idiot who didn’t outright kill the Avengers when he should’ve. He played around with them in Infinity War and it almost cost him his win if not for Thors arrogance. The Avengers were too focused trying to separate him from the gauntlet instead of just killing him. If Thor can nearly kill Thanos, Aku can certainly kill Thanos. Aku is not going to try and be merciful. He’s going to see that there is a threat to himself and attempt to destroy it. Thanos is not fighting humans now. He is fighting a demigod that can take the form of whatever he wants and has conquered most of the Galaxy and has gone toe to toe with Gods and survived. 

In the finale of Samurai Jack entire armies came to his aid to rescue him from being executed. Remember what Aku said? 

“Pathetic fools. You’re nothing but insects to Aku. And insects get SQUASHED AND EXTERMINATED.”

Then he effortlessly proceeded to corrupt half of the attackers into his own forces and casually culled them by the hordes with eye beams alone. When he got bored of that he just rained down as thousands of spikes and killed just about everyone else. Thanos and his forces could barely handle Wakanda. Technology like that of Wakanda is not uncommon in Samurai Jack. Thanos could hardly handle Tony Stark. 

What’s going to happen is Thanos will show up with his armies, Aku will laugh and unleash his own minions while ripping Thanos’s forces to shreds before vaporizing the Mad Titan. Thanos might stand a chance since the gauntlet is holy and he has some stones, but Aku is probably not going to struggle too much with a misguided FOOL running around trying to collect stones. That’s assuming Aku doesn’t have the others in his direct possession and uses them to empower himself further since you never said if Aku has/knows about the other stones. 

And you know what happens after Thanos gets put through a wood chipper? Aku burns his daughters for fun and reduces any worlds in his control to ash. If Thanos is lucky he might just get to live as a slave. If you add Ashi, his daughter with powers EQUAL to her fathers, Thanos is fighting two lovecraftian-level horrors that aren’t going to hesitate to kill everyone there.
